skills.name: The Vein
skills.description: The low hum in water, bone, and radio through the Orrocanopy. It is the Marrow listening for a pattern to finish.

skills.name: Selenqari knot-glyphs
skills.description: A script of stone cords read by touch and shadow-angle. In the city's grammar, ask and finish are the same word.

skills.name: The Marrow Bell
skills.description: A cistern-heart that submits a living question to the Marrow. The answer arrives as completion of flesh and system, not as words.

skills.name: Blocker protocol
skills.description: Twelve-hour scent blockers and logged suppressants. An alpha protection officer leaves the tent if an omega's suppressants fail.
